comparison.objective: Buckle two harness tongues and close/position a chest clip on a doll; candidate instead commissions and locks an adjustable robot-axis damper through repeated guarded impact cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Harness task tests retrieving and inserting two tongues, snap-latching a chest clip, and safe bimanual placement near a doll. Candidate tests recessed hex-key engagement, setscrew loosening/retightening, fine collar rotation, counterholding, bounded torque, and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Harness success requires both tongues latched, clip closed within 2 cm of the armpit line, hands withdrawn, and stillness, with seat/head safety limits. Candidate requires physical unlock-adjust-lock, control actuation, and two repeatable ≥0.85 J cycles within stroke, rebound, overload, hard-stop, and drift limits. Harness rubric lacks insertion-force and latch-force thresholds, but these omissions do not suggest duplication.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and closed-loop abilities differ materially: discrete safety-harness insertion/latching versus tool-mediated mechanical tuning and dynamic validation.
